nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What specific changes do S. japonica gametophytes undergo to acclimate to high seawater temperatures?
nodes.answer: They undergo transformations of amino acids, changes in sugar metabolism, and intensification of the innate immune system.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Ocean acidification|Acidification effects on seagrasses_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What specific effects on communities are less understood in relation to seagrass meadows?
nodes.answer: The specific effects of fragmentation and edge effects on epifaunal and infaunal communities are less understood.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Ocean acidification|Acidification effects on seagrasses_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How do bryophytes react to changes in their environment?
nodes.answer: Bryophytes take up nutrients over their whole leaf surface area and can react quickly to environmental changes, which may be influenced by the conditions created by fast- or slow-growing vascular plant communities.
